name: Xandl Stadl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Xandl Stadl in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of Tyrolean hospitality in the charming **Xandl Stadl**, where tradition meets warmth in every corner. Nestled in the picturesque region of **Tirol**, this cozy inn invites you to savor authentic flavors, from hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** to melt-in-your-mouth **Kaiserschmarrn**, all paired with the finest local **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grauburgunder**.

After a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** or the historic streets of **Innsbruck**, unwind in our rustic yet inviting atmosphere. Whether you're here for the breathtaking **Alpenpanorama**, the thrill of skiing in **St. Anton** or **Ischgl**, or simply to relax in the soothing **Almwiesen**, **Xandl Stadl** is your perfect retreat.

Indulge in our signature dishes, crafted with love using the freshest ingredients from the **Tiroler Alps**. Don’t miss our famous **Tiroler Speckknödel** or a comforting bowl of **Käsespätzle**—pure comfort food at its best.

For families, we offer a warm welcome with kid-friendly menus and plenty of space to explore. And after dinner, enjoy a cozy evening by the fireplace with a slice of homemade **Apfelstrudel** and a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** fondue.

**Xandl Stadl**—where every visit feels like coming home. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
